meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把互相依赖的一批任务按阶段依次跑完,失败自动重试接管
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一堆有先后依赖的任务需要按顺序自动跑完
copy.tagline_en: Run a batch of dependency-ordered tasks phase by phase, retrying failures automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a set of tasks with dependencies must run automatically in order

howto.what: 把有先后依赖的多个任务编成一张任务图,按依赖分波派给子代理执行,一个阶段一次运行;某个节点失败或跑偏时可只重试、续传或改写那一个节点,已完成节点的结果会复用。
howto.when: 当你提到 mass-ulw、任务 DAG,或需要「某些任务必须先完成、另一些才能开始」的多代理工作时触发接管。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次重构拆成任务图跑起来
say.note: 会先读规划文档,再定义并启动运行

say.text: 重试 rewrite 这个节点,顺便改一下它的指令
say.note: 只给该节点一次新尝试,已完成节点不动

say.text: run_stub_1 里的 verify 跑偏了,发消息把它拉回范围
say.note: 给单个子节点发消息,运行中直接纠偏

howto.what_en: Turns a dependency-ordered job into a task graph and drives its nodes through child agents in dependency-ordered waves, one run per phase. A failed or drifting node can be retried, steered, or amended; finished nodes keep their cached results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to run this refactor as a task graph
say_en.note: Reads the planning doc, then defines and starts the run

say_en.text: Retry the rewrite node and edit its prompt while you're at it
say_en.note: Fresh attempt for that one node only

say_en.text: verify in run_stub_1 drifted - send it a scope correction
say_en.note: Messages one child node; steers it mid-run
